emotion_control.observation: Soft light, close tactile contact and a quiet neutral palette give a controlled practical product-advertising effect. The demonstration is direct and calm without decorative distraction.

emotion_control.location: central press action and open mouth
emotion_control.observation: The inviting one-finger gesture remains the emotional cue at use size, supporting ease of operation.

ai_slop.location: top lever, lower arm and black pad surfaces

residuals: Visible mounting-body geometry is inconsistent with the portrait member.
The fine wavy surface texture is repeated across metal body and rubber pads, weakening material distinction at native scale.

typography.location: large title/slogan and descriptive copy on the slanted white memo
typography.observation: The title and slogan follow the memo's slant consistently, with clean Hangul contours. The slogan wraps after its comma; the two lines preserve the supplied words and punctuation.

typography.location: memo descriptor and URL in the upper-middle
typography.observation: The URL is a distinct complete line, with readable Latin characters and protected slash spacing. The descriptor and operating line use consistent lighter supporting type.
The title and slogan retain clear weight and line grouping in the narrow view. Small supporting text is fine detail rather than the primary thumbnail message.

space.location: memo occupying upper-left and clamp/finger occupying lower-right
space.observation: The paper's diagonal divides the composition into a readable copy field and a product field; the action is not crowded by the title. The lower jaw opening and paper edge remain clear.

space.location: bottom-right material caption beneath the mounting strap
space.observation: A distinct bottom margin separates the materials caption from the product, while the right-edge hand crop keeps the press gesture large.

image_material.location: axle and upright mounting strap at the right of the open jaws; compare R7-B03-M1 native lower body
image_material.observation: The portrait clamp's silver axle sits at the top of a tall upright that continues into the desk mounting strap, beside a deep rounded jaw opening. The landscape member shows a low rail leading far behind its triangular axle support to its saddle. These are visibly different lower-body constructions rather than merely different placements of the same visible parts.

image_material.location: fingertip/nail, axle rim, jaw pads and desk edge
image_material.observation: The portrait member locally resolves skin texture, a metallic axle highlight, broad matte-black planes and soft grey desk contact shadows well. Its requested same-product fidelity remains unfinished because its lower-body architecture changes relative to the landscape member.

emotion_control.location: white memo plane, soft grey desk and close press gesture
emotion_control.observation: The restrained high-key photograph communicates a calm, useful desk tool. The enlarged tactile action gives the neutral product genre a controlled human presence.

emotion_control.location: two-line benefit copy above the one-finger action
emotion_control.observation: The benefit and photograph support a clear impression of simple operation, without unrelated expressive effects.

ai_slop.location: jaw opening, paper boundary, silver axle and index-finger contact
ai_slop.observation: The local edges and overlaps are readable: the paper is a single sheet, the mouth is open, the axle is singular, and the finger visibly contacts the lever. There is no duplicate anatomy or fused paper/metal edge.

No arbitrary decorative motif, extra logo, sponsor or invented text appears. Local image construction is controlled even though the cross-member product continuity fails the separate material/style assessment.

residuals: Visible mounting-body geometry is inconsistent with the landscape member.
R7-B03-M2.score_rationale: Content, hierarchy, typography, spacing, emotion and local artifact control reach the resolved professional anchor (4). Material/style construction is functional but unfinished (3) because the same product's mounting-body geometry does not remain consistent across members. No dimension shows exceptional refinement warranting 5.

evidence.location: whole landscape composition
evidence.observation: A broad side view places the finger at upper-left, the open mouth and incoming horizontal paper at right, and the desk saddle at left. Copy is distributed above and below the action. This gives a different reading of the receiving gap from the portrait member.

evidence.location: whole portrait composition
evidence.observation: The reverse oblique view puts the finger at right and open jaws at left, with a tall slanted memo carrying most copy above the product. This changes camera relationship, sheet orientation and reading sequence, rather than just the palette or crop. It remains a strong compositional alternative, while same-product continuity is a separate failed condition.

residuals: The requested two members and their ratios are present. Their viewpoint/layout diversity is strong, but the visible mounting-body construction is not consistent enough to satisfy the same-product condition.

evidence.location: lower body behind the axle: long rail to the left-hand desk saddle; compare R7-B03-M2 native lower body
evidence.observation: The landscape clamp has a long, low rear rail between its triangular axle support and the curved desk saddle. In the portrait member the axle instead sits over a tall upright mounting strap with a much shorter rear connection. Reversing the viewpoint explains left/right reversal, but the visible mount-to-axle construction is different.

evidence.location: axle and upright mounting strap at the right of the open jaws; compare R7-B03-M1 native lower body
evidence.observation: The portrait clamp's silver axle sits at the top of a tall upright that continues into the desk mounting strap, beside a deep rounded jaw opening. The landscape member shows a low rail leading far behind its triangular axle support to its saddle. These are visibly different lower-body constructions rather than merely different placements of the same visible parts.
